sentences.en: CARL: Hi, come and take a seat
sentences.zh: CARL: 嗨，请坐。

sentences.en: JULIE: Thank you
sentences.zh: JULIE: 谢谢。

sentences.en: CARL: My name's Carl Rogers and I'm one of the doctors here at the Total Health Clinic
sentences.zh: CARL: 我叫卡尔·罗杰斯，是全健康诊所的医生之一。

sentences.en: So I understand this is your first visit to the clinic?
sentences.zh: 所以，我了解到这是您第一次来本诊所就诊，对吗？

sentences.en: JULIE: Yes, it is
sentences.zh: JULIE: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: CARL: OK. well I hope you'll be very happy with the service you receive here
sentences.zh: CARL: 好的，希望您在这里享受到的服务令您非常满意。

sentences.en: So if it's alright with you I'll take a few details to help me give you the best possible service
sentences.zh: 那么，如果您不介意的话，我需要记录一些基本信息，以便为您提供最优质的服务。

sentences.en: JULIE: Sure
sentences.zh: JULIE: 当然可以。

sentences.en: CARL: So can I check first of all that we have the correct personal details for you?
sentences.zh: CARL: 首先，让我确认一下我们是否已掌握您正确的个人信息？

sentences.en: So your full name is Julie Anne Garcia?
sentences.zh: 您的全名是朱莉·安妮·加西亚，对吗？

sentences.en: Example
sentences.zh: 示例

sentences.en: JULIE: That's correct
sentences.zh: JULIE: 没错。

sentences.en: CARL: Perfect
sentences.zh: CARL: 很好。

sentences.en: And can have a contact phone number?
sentences.zh: 请问可以提供一个联系电话吗？

sentences.en: JULIE: It's 219 442 9785
sentences.zh: JULIE: 电话号码是219-442-9785。

sentences.en: CARL: OK, and then can I just check that we have the correct date of birth?
sentences.zh: CARL: 好的。另外，请允许我再核对一下您的出生日期是否正确？

sentences.en: JULIE: October tenth, 1992
sentences.zh: JULIE: 1992年10月10日。

sentences.en: CARL: Oh, actually have 1991, I'll just correct that now
sentences.zh: CARL: 哦，实际上我们系统里登记的是1991年，我现在就更正过来。

sentences.en: Right, so that's all good
sentences.zh: 好的，这些信息都已确认无误。

sentences.en: Now just need just a few more personal details full-time or part-time?
sentences.zh: 接下来还需要了解几项个人信息：您目前是全职还是兼职工作？

sentences.en: do you have an occupation, either A
sentences.zh: 您有职业吗？选项A……

sentences.en: JULIE: Yes, work full-time in Esterhazy's - you know, the restaurant chain
sentences.zh: JULIE: 有，我在埃斯特哈齐连锁餐厅全职工作——您知道的，就是那家连锁餐厅。

sentences.en: I started off as a waitress there a few years ago and I'm a manager now
sentences.zh: 几年前我刚入职时是一名服务员，现在已升任经理。

sentences.en: CARL: Oh I know them, yeah, they're down on 114th Street, aren't they?
sentences.zh: CARL: 哦，我知道这家店，对吧？他们应该在第114街，是吗？

sentences.en: JULIE: That's right
sentences.zh: JULIE: 没错。

sentences.en: CARL: Yeah, I've been there a few times
sentences.zh: CARL: 是啊，我去过好几次。

sentences.en: I just love their salads
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢他们的沙拉。

sentences.en: JULIE: That's good to hear
sentences.zh: JULIE: 听到这个真高兴。

sentences.en: CARL: Right, so one more thing I need to know before we talk about why you're here, Julie, and that's the name of your insurance company
sentences.zh: CARL: 好的，朱莉，在我们讨论您此次就诊原因之前，我还需确认一件事：您的保险公司名称。

sentences.en: JULIE: It's Cawley Life Insurance, that's C-A-W-L-E-Y
sentences.zh: JULIE: 是考利人寿保险公司，拼写为C-A-W-L-E-Y。

sentences.en: CARL: Excellent, thank you so much
sentences.zh: CARL: 太好了，非常感谢！

sentences.en: CARL: Now Julie, let's look at how we can help you
sentences.zh: CARL: 现在，朱莉，我们来看看如何帮到您。

sentences.en: So tell me a little about what brought you here today
sentences.zh: 请告诉我，今天是什么原因促使您前来就诊？

sentences.en: JULIE: Well, I've been getting a pain in my knee, the left one
sentences.zh: JULIE: 嗯，我的左膝一直有疼痛感。

sentences.en: Not very serious at first, but it's gotten worse, so I thought I ought to see someone about it
sentences.zh: 起初并不严重，但最近越来越厉害了，所以我决定找医生看看。

sentences.en: CARL: That's certainly the right decision
sentences.zh: CARL: 这确实是明智之举。

sentences.en: So how long have you been aware of this pain?
sentences.zh: 那么，您意识到这种疼痛有多久了？

sentences.en: Is it just a few days, or is it longer than that?
sentences.zh: 是仅仅几天，还是更久一些？

sentences.en: JULIE: Longer
sentences.zh: JULIE: 更久一些。

sentences.en: It's been worse for the last couple of days, but it's three weeks since l first noticed it
sentences.zh: 最近两天疼痛加剧了，但我最早是在三周前注意到这个问题的。

sentences.en: It came on quite gradually though, so I kind of ignored it at first
sentences.zh: 虽然症状是逐渐出现的，但我一开始有点忽视了。

sentences.en: CARL: And have you taken any medication yourself, or treated it in anyway?
sentences.zh: CARL: 你自己有没有服用过任何药物，或者采取过其他治疗方式？

sentences.en: JULIE: Yeah, I've been taking medication to deal with the pain, Tylenol, and that works OK for a few hours
sentences.zh: JULIE: 是的，我一直在服用止痛药，比如泰诺（Tylenol），效果还不错，能缓解几个小时。

sentences.en: But I don't like to keep taking it
sentences.zh: 但我不喜欢一直服用它。

sentences.en: CARL: OK
sentences.zh: CARL: 好的。

sentences.en: And what about heat treatment?
sentences.zh: 那热敷治疗呢？

sentences.en: Have you tried applying heat at all?
sentences.zh: 你试过用热敷吗？

sentences.en: JULIE: No, but have been using ice on it for the last few days
sentences.zh: JULIE: 没有，不过过去几天我一直用冰敷。

sentences.en: CARL: And does that seem to help the pain at all?
sentences.zh: CARL: 那冰敷对缓解疼痛有帮助吗？

sentences.en: JULIE: A little, yes
sentences.zh: JULIE: 有一点，是的。

sentences.en: CARL: Good
sentences.zh: CARL: 很好。

sentences.en: Now you look as if you're quite fit normally?
sentences.zh: 你现在看起来平时身体状况相当不错？

sentences.en: JULIE: am, yes
sentences.zh: JULIE: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: CARL: So do you do any a sport on a regular basis?
sentences.zh: CARL: 那你平时会定期进行某项体育运动吗？

sentences.en: JULIE: a Yes, I play a lot of tennis
sentences.zh: JULIE: 是的，我经常打网球。

sentences.en: I belong to a club a SO go there a lot
sentences.zh: 我加入了一个俱乐部，所以常去那里。

sentences.en: I'm quite competitive so I enjoy that side of it as well as the exercise
sentences.zh: 我竞争意识比较强，因此既享受运动本身，也喜欢其中的竞争性。

sentences.en: But I haven't gone since this started
sentences.zh: 但自从这次症状开始后，我就没再去过了。

sentences.en: CARL: Sure
sentences.zh: CARL: 明白了。

sentences.en: And do you do any other types of exercise?
sentences.zh: 那你还会做其他类型的锻炼吗？

sentences.en: JULIE: Yeah, I sometimes do a little swimming, but usually just when I'm on vacation
sentences.zh: JULIE: 是的，有时会游一会儿泳，但通常只在度假时才游。

sentences.en: But normally I go running a few times a week, maybe three or four times
sentences.zh: 不过平时我每周会跑几次步，大概三到四次。

sentences.en: CARL: Hmm
sentences.zh: CARL: 嗯。

sentences.en: So your legs are getting quite a pounding
sentences.zh: 所以你的双腿承受着相当大的冲击力。

sentences.en: But you haven't had any problems up to now?
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，你腿部一直没出过问题？

sentences.en: JULIE: No, not with my legs
sentences.zh: JULIE: 没有，我的腿一直没问题。

sentences.en: I did have an accident last year when I slipped and hurt my shoulder, but that's better now
sentences.zh: 去年我曾出过一次意外，滑倒伤到了肩膀，但现在已痊愈。

sentences.en: CARL: Excellent
sentences.zh: CARL: 很好。

sentences.en: And do you have any allergies?
sentences.zh: 你有过敏史吗？

sentences.en: JULIE: No, none that I'm aware of
sentences.zh: JULIE: 没有，至少我自己目前没意识到有任何过敏。

sentences.en: CARL: And do you take any medication on a regular basis?
sentences.zh: CARL: 那你是否长期服用某种药物？

sentences.en: JULIE: Well, I take vitamins but that's all
sentences.zh: JULIE: 嗯，我只服用维生素，别的没有。

sentences.en: I'm generally very healthy
sentences.zh: 我总体来说非常健康。

sentences.en: CARL: OK, well let's have a closer look and see what might be causing this problem
sentences.zh: CARL: 好的，那我们来仔细检查一下，看看可能是什么原因导致了这个问题。

sentences.en: If you can just get up
sentences.zh: 请你站起来一下。
